This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER 1 .

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 5.12.2023 in connection with Crime No. 372/2023, registered at Police Station Bijadandi District Mandla for the offence punishable under Sections 305, 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is a young boy of aged about 19 years and deceased was aged about 18 years.
It is submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application and submitted that applicant has given memorandum that there was love relationship between them.
Applicant repeatedly committed sexual intercourse with the prosecutrix, but refused to marry, therefore she has committed suicide.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Considering the prosecution story and the evidence collected in the case diary, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

7. In addition to that the applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437 (3)
of Cr. P. C..
Certified copy as per rules.

( VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
